title: Trial of Chaos: 30-room runs for Trialmaster Fates
summary: Since 0.5.5 a Trial of Chaos can be paused and resumed, pays a chest per room and rewards only Currency and Soul Cores. Continue a finished 10-room trial twice for up to 30 rooms and a Trialmaster Fragment per stage, then fight the Trialmaster or sell the Fates.

budget.build_needs: Clears 10 to 30 rooms of stacking modifiers; the elite monsters are more dangerous since 0.5.5.

claim.note: Editorial estimate from the 0.5.5 changes; not measured.

yields.why: One of the three Trialmaster Fragments placed in the door at the end of a Trial of Chaos; 0.5.5 awards a different fragment for each successful continued run.
Trialmaster Fragment; reaching later rooms can yield all three in one run (GGG).
Trialmaster Fragment; the third door fragment.
poe2db's Trial of Chaos wager table lists Divine Orb x2 and Divine Orb x5.
One of the uniques the Trialmaster drops.

claim.note: 0.5.5 gives the Trial level-based inherent bonuses 'to compensate for Atlas Passive Bonuses not applying inside the Trial of Chaos', so no master or atlas setup is listed.

waystone.notes: A Trial of Chaos is entered with an Inscribed Ultimatum at The Temple of Chaos, not through a Waystone.

steps: Take an Inscribed Ultimatum to The Temple of Chaos (Act 3) to start a Trial of Chaos; poe2db lists 10 rooms at level 75.
Choose the modifiers at the start of each encounter: since 0.5.5 the difficulty modifiers applied between rooms also raise the quality of drops.
Each room ends in a reward chest, and you can leave and resume from the same room later (0.5.5).
After 10 rooms, continue without a new Ultimatum, up to twice: the modifiers carry over and each successful continuation awards a different Trialmaster Fragment.
When continuing you may take the double-or-nothing currency wager.
Place Deadly, Cowardly and Victorious Fate in the door at the end of a Trial of Chaos to fight the Trialmaster, or sell them.
risks: Atlas passives do not apply inside the Trial of Chaos; 0.5.5 adds level-based inherent bonuses instead.
Run rewards are only Currency and Soul Cores since 0.5.5 (no corrupted items); which Soul Cores drop is not documented, so the basket lists none.
The wager is double or nothing.
The Trialmaster no longer drops Magic Inscribed Ultimatums (0.5.5).
The Trialmaster uniques have no exchange price here.
